searchText: Hi, I have a question regarding the specs :). The function `compute_proposer_index` seems to only need the seed of the epoch as source of pseudo randomness to determine the new proposer. So I was wondering how this function could be used to choose several proposers during a whole epoch ? Isn't there a need to incorporate the slot in the pseudo randomness?
